details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and the `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B. The orchestrator and poller (`orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C. The clarify, plan or implement phase workflows
D. Documentation only (`README.md`, `docs/`, an `agents.d/` fragment)
E. None of these. I will reply with the exact file, workflow or behaviour, and what is wrong with it today. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What outcome would show the issue is done?
Choices:
A. A specific bug or failing run is fixed. I will give the run ID, error or issue number. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Measurable speed or cost goes down. I will give the metric and the target.
C. A specific new capability is added. I will describe it.
D. No concrete outcome. Close this issue as not actionable.
